paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : Wait-k Policy
model_annotation: The figure illustrates the relationship between BLEU score and Average Lagging (AL) for three different methods under the Wait-k policy in simultaneous machine translation. The vertical axis represents BLEU score, ranging from 20 to 30 with linear increments of 2, and the horizontal axis represents Average Lagging (AL), ranging from 0 to 8 with linear increments of 2. Three distinct lines, each with a unique marker and color, represent different consistency-based approaches: a blue dashed line with circular markers for "Consistency-CE", an orange dashed line with triangular markers for "Consistency-Bi + sampling", and a green dashed line with square markers for "Consistency-Bi + beam". All three methods show an increasing trend in BLEU score as AL increases. At AL=0, the BLEU scores are approximately 20 for Consistency-CE, 24 for Consistency-Bi + sampling, and 23 for Consistency-Bi + beam. At AL=8, the BLEU scores reach approximately 28.5 for Consistency-CE, 29.5 for Consistency-Bi + sampling, and 29.2 for Consistency-Bi + beam. The legend is located in the lower-right corner of the plot, clearly associating each line style and marker with its corresponding method. The figure uses a grid with dashed horizontal lines to aid in reading the values.
